title_vi: Kafka có làm mất tin không? Có, ở ba chỗ, và đây là cách thấy tận mắt

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a partial clone of the source repository; git hash-object of the retrieved body matches the source-map blob. No source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Thứ tự lưu vị trí đọc quyết định mất hay trùng tin ở bên nhận.
Partition, leader và bản sao của Kafka.

claims.evidence: The Replication, Unclean leader election and Availability and Durability Guarantees sections of the Kafka design page and the Eligible Leader Replicas operations page were read from a partial clone of apache/kafka; the acknowledgement, visibility and loss results were measured by the author, who ran them on Kafka 4.4.0 (one controller and three brokers on one machine) with confluent-kafka 2.16.0 on 2026-10-18.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered lesson.md (markdown-it, tables enabled, every <details> open, a 16 px page gutter) at each width: the page never scrolled sideways and the figure was scaled to the column; the smallest SVG font-size times that scale is the recorded minimum at 320 px. `python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser` measured every line of the figure in Chromium inside its box. Not GitHub, not a real phone and not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: A message is committed only when all in-sync replicas have it and the ISR is no smaller than min(min.insync.replicas, replica count); with f+1 replicas Kafka tolerates f failures without losing committed messages; Kafka does not require fsync on every write and a rejoining replica must fully re-sync; unclean leader election is disabled by default since 0.11.0.0 and can be enabled with unclean.leader.election.enable; producers choose acks 0, 1 or all; min.insync.replicas only takes effect with acks=all and makes the partition reject writes below that ISR size.
claims.section: Replicated Logs; Unclean leader election; Availability and Durability Guarantees
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

claims.claim_vi: With the strict min ISR rule the high watermark cannot advance while the ISR is smaller than min(min.insync.replicas, replica count); Eligible Leader Replicas (from 4.0, enabled by default on new clusters from 4.1) lets the controller elect replicas outside the ISR that are safe, choosing ISR first, then unfenced ELR, then the last known leader.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of apache/kafka at commit 65566690ca1ddb584388c1026e2ff6673e9c6f19.

claims.claim_vi: Measured on Kafka 4.4.0, topic orders with replicas on brokers 1, 2, 3 and min.insync.replicas=2: 100 acks=all messages were acknowledged; with brokers 2 and 3 stopped (ISR [1]) 100 acks=all messages were not acknowledged and the broker logged NotEnoughReplicasException; 100 acks=1 messages were acknowledged but a consumer of broker 1 saw only the first 100; after kill -9 of broker 1 and restarting 2 and 3, broker 3 led with ISR [2, 3]; after broker 1 returned, only the first 100 messages remained.
claims.verified_by: The author ran and measured this on 2026-10-18; unclean leader election was left at its default.

claims.claim_vi: The source states: Kafka can lose messages: the producer needs proper acks and retries; brokers flush asynchronously so an instance down before the flush loses messages, and replicas must be configured; consumer auto-commit can acknowledge records before processing; combine synchronous and asynchronous commits. The lesson does not adopt the flush wording: per the Kafka design document durability comes from replication (see source_deviations).

design_notes_vi: Bốn bước thử với số đo thật, ba chỗ có thể mất tin nối từ bên gửi tới bên nhận, bốn cấu hình giữ tin. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source says brokers lose messages that were not flushed before a crash; the lesson follows the Kafka design document, where durability comes from replication rather than fsync, and shows a loss caused by acks=1 instead.
The lesson adds min.insync.replicas, the strict min ISR rule and Eligible Leader Replicas of Kafka 4.x, measured; it leaves out the producer's internal threads.
